title: Français 14765 — p351
contents: An alchemical recipe using mercury, with promises of success and a warning against misuse.
fields: 37 symbols, 36 letter signs, 1 ligature; 2 unidentified signs

excerpt: **soies sure, que vous aures reusi dans vos entrepresi, enco[r] vous seres heureux, si vous non feres acun mau vaise usage —**
translation: Be assured that you will have succeeded in your undertakings, and that you will be happy if you make no bad use of it.

excerpt: **Ceux, qui auront le bonheur, de décou[v]rir cet secret, seront heureux, etant bon chretien, et suivant ce, qui suit —**
translation: Those fortunate enough to discover this secret will be happy, provided they are good Christians and follow what comes next.
